captureDefinition: 100*(gross exit price / frozen effective entry price - 1)/(strictly later same-session best High upside /100), if upside>0 and confirmed exit; evaluator only; sell cost reversed once from confirmed net PnL to recover gross sell price
eligibility: reporter reads outputs after all funding/EXIT decisions; does not feed back into action, rank or sizing
inputRequirement: saved 16-fit manifest, saved layer-A rows, saved integrated ledgers and independent no-fit audit PASS; no additional fit or new decision
layerA: same archived control funded IDs and quantities, control R50-A vs candidate Net and evaluator-only upside, as-of exit from exact saved calendar; no changed-funded cash credit
percentiles: NumPy percentile linear p05/p10 on evaluable Net returns; no null-as-zero
pnlDefinition: reported same-quantity confirmed PnL, no hypothetical high sale; unresolved=null for net and holding; no double booking of trade cost
profitFactor: sum positive closed PnL / absolute sum negative closed PnL, null if denominator zero
r50Reason: baseline owned checkpoint reason at same candidate SELL_INTENT minute; absent match means outside control owned prefix, no extrapolation
recycling: actual newly funded and displaced IDs in independent IM/R1 cash replay, postEntryUpside >=5/10 counts evaluator-only, closed-currency identity via frozen pnl_delta; unresolved difference remains null
